datasets.name: uc_route_hour
queryLines:
WITH trip_level AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(`Day` AS DATE) AS `Day`,
    `Route`,
    `Ride Id`,
    CAST(`Ride Start` AS TIMESTAMP) AS `Ride Start`,
    HOUR(CAST(`Ride Start` AS TIMESTAMP)) AS `Hour`,
    SUM(CAST(`Riders On` AS INT)) AS trip_on,
    SUM(CAST(`Riders Off` AS INT)) AS trip_off,
    (
      MAX(unix_timestamp(CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)))
        - MIN(unix_timestamp(CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)))
    )
      / 3600.0 AS trip_hours
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/DayRange 2026-08-13 2026-08-30.csv',
      format => 'csv',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    `Ride State` != 'Cancelled'
    AND (
      :date_filter IS NULL
      OR CAST(`Day` AS DATE) = :date_filter
    )
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    `Day`,
    Route,
    `Hour`,
    SUM(trip_on) AS RidersOn,
    SUM(trip_off) AS RidersOff,
    SUM(trip_on) + SUM(trip_off) AS TotalActivity,
    ROUND(SUM(trip_hours), 2) AS RevenueHours
  FROM
    trip_level
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
),
route_totals AS (
  SELECT
    Route,
    SUM(RidersOn) AS t_on,
    SUM(RidersOff) AS t_off,
    SUM(TotalActivity) AS t_act,
    ROUND(SUM(RevenueHours), 2) AS t_rh
  FROM
    base
  GROUP BY
    1
)
SELECT
  b.*,
  CASE
    WHEN :metric_filter = 'RidersOn' THEN b.RidersOn
    WHEN :metric_filter = 'RidersOff' THEN b.RidersOff
    WHEN :metric_filter = 'RevenueHours' THEN b.RevenueHours
    ELSE b.TotalActivity
  END AS SelectedMetric,
  CONCAT(
    b.Route,
    ' (',
    CAST(
      CASE
        WHEN :metric_filter = 'RidersOn' THEN rt.t_on
        WHEN :metric_filter = 'RidersOff' THEN rt.t_off
        WHEN :metric_filter = 'RevenueHours' THEN rt.t_rh
        ELSE rt.t_act
      END AS STRING
    ),
    ')'
  ) AS RouteLabel
FROM
  base b
    JOIN route_totals rt
      ON b.Route = rt.Route
ORDER BY
  b.Hour

datasets.name: uc_trip_stops_mean
queryLines:
WITH alt_routes AS (
  SELECT
    _c0 AS StopName,
    _c1 AS HasAlt,
    _c2 AS AltRoute
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/summaryofRoute3and4StopsbyExistenceofAlternativeRoutes.xlsx',
      format => 'excel',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    _c0 != 'Unique Stops on route Tamarack or Almaden'
),
raw AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/DayRange 2026-08-13 2026-08-30.csv',
      format => 'csv',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    `Ride State` != 'Cancelled'
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, CAST(`Day` AS DATE)
        ORDER BY CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)
      ) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, CAST(`Day` AS DATE)) AS total_stops,
    FIRST_VALUE(`Stop`) OVER (
        PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, CAST(`Day` AS DATE)
        ORDER BY CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)
      ) AS first_stop,
    LAST_VALUE(`Stop`) OVER (
        PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, CAST(`Day` AS DATE)
        ORDER BY CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS last_stop
  FROM
    raw
),
stop_seq AS (
  SELECT
    t.`Ride Id`,
    CASE
      WHEN
        t.rn = 1
        AND t.first_stop = t.last_stop
      THEN
        CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' (Start)', COALESCE(CONCAT(' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']'), ''))
      WHEN
        t.rn = t.total_stops
        AND t.first_stop = t.last_stop
      THEN
        CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' (End)', COALESCE(CONCAT(' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']'), ''))
      WHEN ar.HasAlt = 'true' THEN CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']')
      ELSE t.`Stop`
    END AS Stop,
    t.rn AS seq
  FROM
    tagged t
      LEFT JOIN alt_routes ar
        ON t.`Stop` = ar.StopName
),
stop_order AS (
  SELECT
    Stop,
    MAX(seq) AS StopOrder
  FROM
    stop_seq
  GROUP BY
    Stop
),
src AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.`Day` AS DATE) AS dt,
    t.`Route`,
    CASE
      WHEN
        t.rn = 1
        AND t.first_stop = t.last_stop
      THEN
        CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' (Start)', COALESCE(CONCAT(' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']'), ''))
      WHEN
        t.rn = t.total_stops
        AND t.first_stop = t.last_stop
      THEN
        CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' (End)', COALESCE(CONCAT(' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']'), ''))
      WHEN ar.HasAlt = 'true' THEN CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']')
      ELSE t.`Stop`
    END AS `Stop`,
    CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(HOUR(CAST(t.`Ride Start` AS TIMESTAMP)) AS STRING), 2, '0'), ':00') AS `Hour`,
    CASE
      WHEN dayofweek(CAST(t.`Day` AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN 'Weekday'
      WHEN dayofweek(CAST(t.`Day` AS DATE)) = 7 THEN 'Saturday'
      ELSE 'Sunday'
    END AS DayType,
    DATE_FORMAT(CAST(t.`Day` AS DATE), 'yyyy-MM') AS `Month`,
    CAST(t.`Riders On` AS INT) AS riders_on,
    CAST(t.`Riders Off` AS INT) AS riders_off,
    CAST(t.`Riders Cumulative` AS INT) AS riders_cum
  FROM
    tagged t
      LEFT JOIN alt_routes ar
        ON t.`Stop` = ar.StopName
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    dt,
    Route,
    Stop,
    `Hour`,
    DayType,
    `Month`,
    SUM(riders_on) AS RidersOn,
    SUM(riders_off) AS RidersOff,
    SUM(riders_on) + SUM(riders_off) AS TotalActivity
  FROM
    src
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4,
    5,
    6
)
SELECT
  d.Route,
  d.Stop,
  d.`Hour`,
  PERCENTILE(d.TotalActivity, 0.5) AS MedianTotal,
  PERCENTILE(d.RidersOn, 0.5) AS MedianRidersOn,
  PERCENTILE(d.RidersOff, 0.5) AS MedianRidersOff,
  MAX(so.StopOrder) AS StopOrder,
  CASE
    WHEN :metric_filter_median = 'RidersOn' THEN PERCENTILE(d.RidersOn, 0.5)
    WHEN :metric_filter_median = 'RidersOff' THEN PERCENTILE(d.RidersOff, 0.5)
    ELSE PERCENTILE(d.TotalActivity, 0.5)
  END AS SelectedMetric,
  CASE
    WHEN :metric_filter_median = 'RidersOn' THEN 'Riders On'
    WHEN :metric_filter_median = 'RidersOff' THEN 'Riders Off'
    ELSE 'Riders On+Off'
  END AS MetricName
FROM
  daily d
    LEFT JOIN stop_order so
      ON d.Stop = so.Stop
WHERE
  (
    :month_filter IS NULL
    OR d.`Month` = :month_filter
  )
  AND (
    :route_filter IS NULL
    OR d.Route = :route_filter
  )
  AND (
    :daytype_filter IS NULL
    OR d.DayType = :daytype_filter
  )
GROUP BY
  1,
  2,
  3
ORDER BY
  `Hour`

datasets.name: uc_route_hour_mean
queryLines:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(`Day` AS DATE) AS dt,
    `Route`,
    CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(HOUR(CAST(`Ride Start` AS TIMESTAMP)) AS STRING), 2, '0'), ':00') AS `Hour`,
    CAST(`Riders On` AS INT) AS riders_on,
    CAST(`Riders Off` AS INT) AS riders_off
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/DayRange 2026-08-13 2026-08-30.csv',
      format => 'csv',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    `Ride State` != 'Cancelled'
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    dt,
    Route,
    `Hour`,
    CASE
      WHEN dayofweek(dt) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN 'Weekday'
      WHEN dayofweek(dt) = 7 THEN 'Saturday'
      ELSE 'Sunday'
    END AS DayType,
    DATE_FORMAT(dt, 'yyyy-MM') AS `Month`,
    SUM(riders_on) AS RidersOn,
    SUM(riders_off) AS RidersOff,
    SUM(riders_on) + SUM(riders_off) AS TotalActivity
  FROM
    src
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4,
    5
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    Route,
    `Hour`,
    ROUND(AVG(RidersOn), 2) AS MeanRidersOn,
    ROUND(AVG(RidersOff), 2) AS MeanRidersOff,
    ROUND(AVG(TotalActivity), 2) AS MeanTotal
  FROM
    daily
  WHERE
    (
      :month_filter IS NULL
      OR `Month` = :month_filter
    )
    AND (
      :daytype_filter IS NULL
      OR DayType = :daytype_filter
    )
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
)
SELECT
  Route,
  `Hour`,
  MeanRidersOn,
  MeanRidersOff,
  MeanTotal,
  CONCAT(Route, ' (', CAST(CAST(ROUND(SUM(MeanRidersOn) OVER (PARTITION BY Route), 0) AS INT) AS STRING), ')') AS RouteOn,
  CONCAT(Route, ' (', CAST(CAST(ROUND(SUM(MeanRidersOff) OVER (PARTITION BY Route), 0) AS INT) AS STRING), ')') AS RouteOff,
  CONCAT(Route, ' (', CAST(CAST(ROUND(SUM(MeanTotal) OVER (PARTITION BY Route), 0) AS INT) AS STRING), ')') AS RouteTotal
FROM
  agg
ORDER BY
  `Hour`

datasets.name: uc_trip_stops
queryLines:
WITH alt_routes AS (
  SELECT
    _c0 AS StopName,
    _c1 AS HasAlt,
    _c2 AS AltRoute
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/summaryofRoute3and4StopsbyExistenceofAlternativeRoutes.xlsx',
      format => 'excel',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    _c0 != 'Unique Stops on route Tamarack or Almaden'
),
raw AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/DayRange 2026-08-13 2026-08-30.csv',
      format => 'csv',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    `Ride State` != 'Cancelled'
),
sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY r.`Ride Id`, CAST(r.`Day` AS DATE)
        ORDER BY CAST(r.`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)
      ) AS stop_seq
  FROM
    raw r
),
stop_order AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ar.HasAlt = 'true' THEN CONCAT(s.`Stop`, ' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']')
      ELSE s.`Stop`
    END AS StopLabel,
    MAX(s.stop_seq) AS StopOrder
  FROM
    sequenced s
      LEFT JOIN alt_routes ar
        ON s.`Stop` = ar.StopName
  GROUP BY
    1
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    t.`Ride Id`,
    DATE_FORMAT(CAST(t.`Ride Start` AS TIMESTAMP), 'HH:mm') AS RideStartRaw,
    t.`Driver`,
    CASE
      WHEN ar.HasAlt = 'true' THEN CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']')
      ELSE t.`Stop`
    END AS `Stop`,
    CAST(t.`Riders On` AS INT) AS RidersOn,
    CAST(t.`Riders Off` AS INT) AS RidersOff,
    CAST(t.`Riders On` AS INT) + CAST(t.`Riders Off` AS INT) AS TotalActivity,
    CAST(t.`Riders Cumulative` AS INT) AS RidersCumulative,
    HOUR(CAST(t.`Ride Start` AS TIMESTAMP)) AS `Hour`,
    CAST(t.`Day` AS DATE) AS `Day`,
    t.`Route`,
    CASE
      WHEN :metric_filter = 'RidersOn' THEN CAST(t.`Riders On` AS INT)
      WHEN :metric_filter = 'RidersOff' THEN CAST(t.`Riders Off` AS INT)
      WHEN :metric_filter = 'RidersCumulative' THEN CAST(t.`Riders Cumulative` AS INT)
      ELSE CAST(t.`Riders On` AS INT) + CAST(t.`Riders Off` AS INT)
    END AS SelectedMetric,
    so.StopOrder,
    CAST(t.`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP) AS sched_ts
  FROM
    sequenced t
      LEFT JOIN alt_routes ar
        ON t.`Stop` = ar.StopName
      LEFT JOIN stop_order so
        ON so.StopLabel
          = CASE
            WHEN ar.HasAlt = 'true' THEN CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']')
            ELSE t.`Stop`
          END
  WHERE
    (
      :date_filter IS NULL
      OR CAST(t.`Day` AS DATE) = :date_filter
    )
    AND (
      :route_filter IS NULL
      OR t.`Route` = :route_filter
    )
)
SELECT
  `Ride Id`,
  CONCAT(
    RideStartRaw,
    ' ', REGEXP_EXTRACT(`Driver`, '\\(([^)]+)\\)', 1),
    ' (Tot:',
    CAST(SUM(SelectedMetric) OVER (PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, `Day`) AS STRING),
    ', RevHr:',
    CAST(
      ROUND(
        (unix_timestamp(MAX(sched_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, `Day`))
         - unix_timestamp(MIN(sched_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, `Day`))
        ) / 3600.0,
        2
      ) AS STRING
    ),
    ')'
  ) AS `Ride Start Time`,
  `Driver`,
  `Stop`,
  RidersOn,
  RidersOff,
  TotalActivity,
  RidersCumulative,
  `Hour`,
  `Day`,
  `Route`,
  SelectedMetric,
  StopOrder
FROM base
ORDER BY `Day`, RideStartRaw

datasets.name: uc_top_routes
queryLines:
WITH daily_route AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(`Day` AS DATE) AS dt,
    `Route`,
    DATE_FORMAT(CAST(`Day` AS DATE), 'yyyy-MM') AS `Month`,
    CASE
      WHEN dayofweek(CAST(`Day` AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN 'Weekday'
      WHEN dayofweek(CAST(`Day` AS DATE)) = 7 THEN 'Saturday'
      ELSE 'Sunday'
    END AS DayType,
    SUM(CAST(`Riders On` AS INT)) AS daily_on,
    SUM(CAST(`Riders Off` AS INT)) AS daily_off,
    SUM(CAST(`Riders On` AS INT)) + SUM(CAST(`Riders Off` AS INT)) AS daily_activity
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/DayRange 2026-08-13 2026-08-30.csv',
      format => 'csv',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    `Ride State` != 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    daily_route
  WHERE
    (
      :month_filter IS NULL
      OR `Month` = :month_filter
    )
    AND (
      :daytype_filter IS NULL
      OR DayType = :daytype_filter
    )
),
route_means AS (
  SELECT
    Route,
    AVG(daily_activity) AS mean_activity
  FROM
    filtered
  GROUP BY
    1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY dt
        ORDER BY
          CASE
            WHEN :rank_by = 'RidersOn' THEN daily_on
            WHEN :rank_by = 'RidersOff' THEN daily_off
            ELSE daily_activity
          END DESC
      ) AS rnk
  FROM
    filtered f
),
topN AS (
  SELECT
    Route,
    COUNT(*) AS freq
  FROM
    ranked
  WHERE
    rnk <= COALESCE(CAST(:num_routes AS INT), 6)
  GROUP BY
    1
  ORDER BY
    freq DESC
  LIMIT COALESCE(CAST(:num_routes AS INT), 6)
)
SELECT
  f.dt AS `Day`,
  f.Route,
  f.daily_activity AS TotalActivity,
  f.daily_on AS RidersOn,
  f.daily_off AS RidersOff,
  rm.mean_activity,
  CASE
    WHEN :metric_filter_top = 'RidersOn' THEN f.daily_on
    WHEN :metric_filter_top = 'RidersOff' THEN f.daily_off
    ELSE f.daily_activity
  END AS SelectedMetric
FROM
  filtered f
    JOIN topN t
      ON f.Route = t.Route
    JOIN route_means rm
      ON f.Route = rm.Route
ORDER BY
  rm.mean_activity DESC,
  f.dt

SELECT

FROM
  filtered f
    JOIN bottomN t
      ON f.Route = t.Route
    JOIN route_means rm

datasets.name: uc_route_span
queryLines:
WITH trips AS (
  SELECT
    `Route`,
    `Ride Id`,
    MIN(CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)) AS trip_start,
    MAX(CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)) AS trip_end
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/DayRange 2026-08-13 2026-08-30.csv',
      format => 'csv',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    `Ride State` != 'Cancelled'
    AND (
      :date_filter IS NULL
      OR CAST(`Day` AS DATE) = :date_filter
    )
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
)
SELECT
  Route,
  MIN(HOUR(trip_start)) AS first_hour,
  MAX(HOUR(trip_end)) AS last_hour,
  COUNT(DISTINCT `Ride Id`) AS num_trips,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT `Ride Id`) * 1.0 / NULLIF(MAX(HOUR(trip_end)) - MIN(HOUR(trip_start)) + 1, 0),
    2
  ) AS trips_per_hour
FROM
  trips
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  Route

datasets.name: uc_prod_route_hour
queryLines:
WITH trip_level AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(`Day` AS DATE) AS `Day`,
    `Route`,
    `Ride Id`,
    HOUR(MIN(CAST(`Ride Start` AS TIMESTAMP))) AS `Hour`,
    SUM(CAST(`Riders On` AS INT)) AS trip_on,
    SUM(CAST(`Riders Off` AS INT)) AS trip_off,
    (
      MAX(unix_timestamp(CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)))
        - MIN(unix_timestamp(CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)))
    )
      / 3600.0 AS trip_hours
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/DayRange 2026-08-13 2026-08-30.csv',
      format => 'csv',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    `Ride State` != 'Cancelled'
    AND (
      :date_filter IS NULL
      OR CAST(`Day` AS DATE) = :date_filter
    )
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    `Day`,
    Route,
    `Hour`,
    SUM(trip_on) AS RidersOn,
    SUM(trip_off) AS RidersOff,
    SUM(trip_on) + SUM(trip_off) AS TotalActivity,
    ROUND(SUM(trip_hours), 2) AS RevenueHours,
    ROUND(
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(trip_hours) > 0 THEN (SUM(trip_on) + SUM(trip_off)) / SUM(trip_hours)
        ELSE 0
      END,
      2
    ) AS Productivity
  FROM

    )

      OR DayType = :daytype_filter
    )

route_stats AS (
  SELECT
    Route,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN :metric_filter = 'TotalActivity' THEN TotalActivity
        WHEN :metric_filter = 'RevenueHours' THEN RevHours
        WHEN :metric_filter = 'RidersOn' THEN TotalActivity
        ELSE Productivity
      END
    ) AS route_mean,
    STDDEV(
      CASE
        WHEN :metric_filter = 'TotalActivity' THEN TotalActivity
        WHEN :metric_filter = 'RevenueHours' THEN RevHours

datasets.name: uc_trip_stops_max
queryLines:
WITH alt_routes AS (
  SELECT
    _c0 AS StopName,
    _c1 AS HasAlt,
    _c2 AS AltRoute
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/summaryofRoute3and4StopsbyExistenceofAlternativeRoutes.xlsx',
      format => 'excel',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    _c0 != 'Unique Stops on route Tamarack or Almaden'
),
raw AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    read_files(
      '/Volumes/fixedroute/unioncity/data/DayRange 2026-08-13 2026-08-30.csv',
      format => 'csv',
      header => 'true'
    )
  WHERE
    `Ride State` != 'Cancelled'
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, CAST(`Day` AS DATE)
        ORDER BY CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)
      ) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, CAST(`Day` AS DATE)) AS total_stops,
    FIRST_VALUE(`Stop`) OVER (
        PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, CAST(`Day` AS DATE)
        ORDER BY CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)
      ) AS first_stop,
    LAST_VALUE(`Stop`) OVER (
        PARTITION BY `Ride Id`, CAST(`Day` AS DATE)
        ORDER BY CAST(`Scheduled Time` AS TIMESTAMP)
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS last_stop
  FROM
    raw
),
stop_seq AS (
  SELECT
    t.`Ride Id`,
    CASE
      WHEN
        t.rn = 1
        AND t.first_stop = t.last_stop
      THEN
        CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' (Start)', COALESCE(CONCAT(' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']'), ''))
      WHEN
        t.rn = t.total_stops
        AND t.first_stop = t.last_stop
      THEN
        CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' (End)', COALESCE(CONCAT(' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']'), ''))
      WHEN ar.HasAlt = 'true' THEN CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']')
      ELSE t.`Stop`
    END AS Stop,
    t.rn AS seq
  FROM
    tagged t
      LEFT JOIN alt_routes ar
        ON t.`Stop` = ar.StopName
),
stop_order AS (
  SELECT
    Stop,
    MAX(seq) AS StopOrder
  FROM
    stop_seq
  GROUP BY
    Stop
),
src AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.`Day` AS DATE) AS dt,
    t.`Route`,
    CASE
      WHEN
        t.rn = 1
        AND t.first_stop = t.last_stop
      THEN
        CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' (Start)', COALESCE(CONCAT(' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']'), ''))
      WHEN
        t.rn = t.total_stops
        AND t.first_stop = t.last_stop
      THEN
        CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' (End)', COALESCE(CONCAT(' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']'), ''))
      WHEN ar.HasAlt = 'true' THEN CONCAT(t.`Stop`, ' [Alt:', ar.AltRoute, ']')
      ELSE t.`Stop`
    END AS `Stop`,
    CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(HOUR(CAST(t.`Ride Start` AS TIMESTAMP)) AS STRING), 2, '0'), ':00') AS `Hour`,
    CASE
      WHEN dayofweek(CAST(t.`Day` AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN 'Weekday'
      WHEN dayofweek(CAST(t.`Day` AS DATE)) = 7 THEN 'Saturday'
      ELSE 'Sunday'
    END AS DayType,
    DATE_FORMAT(CAST(t.`Day` AS DATE), 'yyyy-MM') AS `Month`,
    CAST(t.`Riders On` AS INT) AS riders_on,
    CAST(t.`Riders Off` AS INT) AS riders_off,
    CAST(t.`Riders Cumulative` AS INT) AS riders_cum
  FROM
    tagged t
      LEFT JOIN alt_routes ar
        ON t.`Stop` = ar.StopName
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    dt,
    Route,
    Stop,
    `Hour`,
    DayType,
    `Month`,
    SUM(riders_on) AS RidersOn,
    SUM(riders_off) AS RidersOff,
    SUM(riders_on) + SUM(riders_off) AS TotalActivity
  FROM
    src
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4,
    5,
    6
)
SELECT
  d.Route,
  d.Stop,
  d.`Hour`,
  MAX(d.TotalActivity) AS MaxTotal,
  MAX(d.RidersOn) AS MaxRidersOn,
  MAX(d.RidersOff) AS MaxRidersOff,
  MAX(so.StopOrder) AS StopOrder,
  CASE
    WHEN :metric_filter_max = 'RidersOn' THEN MAX(d.RidersOn)
    WHEN :metric_filter_max = 'RidersOff' THEN MAX(d.RidersOff)
    ELSE MAX(d.TotalActivity)
  END AS SelectedMetric,
  CASE
    WHEN :metric_filter_max = 'RidersOn' THEN 'Riders On'
    WHEN :metric_filter_max = 'RidersOff' THEN 'Riders Off'
    ELSE 'Riders On+Off'
  END AS MetricName
FROM
  daily d
    LEFT JOIN stop_order so
      ON d.Stop = so.Stop
WHERE
  (
    :month_filter_max IS NULL
    OR d.`Month` = :month_filter_max
  )
  AND (
    :route_filter_max IS NULL
    OR d.Route = :route_filter_max
  )
  AND (
    :daytype_filter_max IS NULL
    OR d.DayType = :daytype_filter_max
  )
GROUP BY
  1,
  2,
  3
ORDER BY
  `Hour`
